philippines.title: Filipino teachers in US urged to follow J-1 visa regulations
philippines.description:
Photo from cfo.gov.ph The United States has welcomed more than 50,000 Filipino participants through its Exchange Visitor Program over the past decade, with teachers accounting for one of the largest groups, the Commission on Filipinos Overseas (CFO) said. As more Filipino educators join the program, the agency has reminded them to comply with J-1 visa requirements, including the two-year home-country residency rule that applies to some participants. The reminder was given during a post-arrival orientation seminar organized by the Philippine Consulate General in Chicago for Filipino teachers working in the United States under the exchange program. 2-year residency rule for J-1 […]...

philippines.title: PCSO lotto results Oct. 21: ₱291.39-M jackpot unwon
philippines.description:
MANILA, Philippines — No jackpot winner emerged in the Grand Lotto 6/55 and MegaLotto 6/45 draws on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026, according to results provided for the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO). The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 13-08-42-14-30-12, carrying a jackpot prize of ₱291.39 million. No ticket holder matched all six numbers, leaving the jackpot unwon. Similarly, the MegaLotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 09-43-40-03-07-31, with a jackpot prize of ₱15 million. No bettor won the top prize. philippines.title: UAAP: Veejay Pre powers UP past UST in double-overtime thriller
philippines.description:
SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89  basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines- Veejay Pre came up big when University of the Philippines needed him most, powering the Fighting Maroons to a 103-101 double-overtime win over the University of Santo Tomas at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. Pre poured in 30 points in his best scoring output with UP and grabbed 16 rebounds, helping his team improve to a league-leading 6-2 record to start the second round of the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament. “We’re happy but we won because of our collective effort,” Pre said, deflecting the spotlight to his teammates.
